root_cause.text: The use of short-circuiting logical OR (`||`) operators in `pidff_init_fields` prevented subsequent `test_and_clear_bit` calls from executing once a previous bit was successfully cleared, leaving some conditional effect bits uncleared in `dev->ffbit`.

bic_trace_step.reason:
This commit introduces the vulnerability. In the function `pidff_init_fields`, it replaces the unconditional `clear_bit` calls with a series of `test_and_clear_bit` calls chained by the logical OR (`||`) operator: 

`if (test_and_clear_bit(FF_SPRING, dev->ffbit) || test_and_clear_bit(FF_DAMPER, dev->ffbit) || ...)`

Because `||` is a short-circuiting operator, if `test_and_clear_bit(FF_SPRING, ...)` returns true, the subsequent `test_and_clear_bit` calls for `FF_DAMPER`, `FF_FRICTION`, and `FF_INERTIA` will not be executed, leaving those bits uncleared in `dev->ffbit`.
